problem: Instagram publication failed after all media gates passed because the publisher queried a stale hardcoded Instagram Business ID.
root_cause: Canonical Composio connection had moved to the active bedrijfsgeheugen.nl account with a different provider business user id, while publisher identity preflight still queried the old id.
prevention: Resolve identity with ig_user_id=me on the pinned canonical connection, verify username bedrijfsgeheugen.nl, and use the returned provider user id for create/publish/readback.
